_comment: Modules that perform physical model HTTP -- an effect-method call whose own URL argument carries a model endpoint fragment (chat/completions, /completions, /v1/responses) -- frozen so the set cannot grow (#36, invariant 2; metric v2 per #1089). maistro.capabilities.providers.llm_gateway is the approved Provider implementation #56 built. The bootstrap model_selector entry is an explicit intentional non-product operator diagnostic: its CLI may probe, while Builders reads only persisted cache/default and never calls the probe implicitly. All other entries are direct callers awaiting governed migration. Enforced by scripts/check-model-egress.py, which ratchets both ways: a new direct caller fails, and an entry that stops calling out fails until pruned, so a migration shrinks this file. Metric v2 replaced the v1 endpoint-text + any-.post heuristic with call-site detection from the curated direct-effect census and a reachability join, pruning the v1 false positive maistro_server.api.chat_completions; the vulture-style authorization path (quality/ratchet-authorizations.json, read from the merge base) is unchanged.
